hookups.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/coleman-landing/ ('Hookups: Partial Hookups, 50 Amp, 30 Amp and 20 Amp, Water'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 54 RV sites with grass pads plus 6 primitive sites; county-wide, primitive camping is tent-only with no water or electric, no RVs.

sites.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/coleman-landing/ ('54 RV Sites', '6 primitive sites') + https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/2025-campground-rules/ ('Primitive camping is tent camping only, with no water or electric. No RVs.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Polk County campground fees in effect from Jan. 1, 2025: water and electric $20 per night, primitive (tent only) $10. Dumping free for registered campers. Cash or check only.

fees.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/2025-campground-rules/ ('The following rule revisions will be in effect beginning Jan. 1, 2025', 'Water and electric : $20 per day', 'Primitive camping: $10 per day', 'Campgrounds only accept cash or check'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'No reservations until more reliable internet becomes available. Campgrounds will remain first-come, first-served until a new online booking system becomes available.' Maximum 14 consecutive days per visit; after a stay of eight or more days a camper must vacate for 28 days; 100 days a year cumulative in Polk County facilities. After-hours entry must be pre-scheduled with the resident caretaker. Checkout noon.

booking.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/2025-campground-rules/ (Rules and Regulations; Maximum Length of Stay: 'maximum length of stay per visit – 14 consecutive days'), read 2026-10-21

note: Polk County campground on Lake Kissimmee, east of Lake Wales, opened 2015. Grass-pad sites under moss-draped oaks; picnic area and boat ramps for airboats, conventional boats and canoes/kayaks. Cash or check only. --Claude
summary: Polk County pages confirm 20/30/50-amp + water partial hookups, 54 RV + 6 primitive sites, showers/flush toilets/dump, first-come first-served. Changed max stay 28 -> 14 consecutive days (2025 rules); added the $20 W/E rate (2025 rules). Note trimmed of hookup/site/booking/rating restatements and the wrong 28-day max.
